symptom: One save that never reached the engine or cloud VM (stopped, reconnecting, offline) set an error that stopped autosave until the next edit, leaving a dirty draft that a later close discarded.
rule: Principles 2 and 7: an unreachable write is unknown, not refused; retry it with bounded backoff and keep the draft journaled, and stop only on a typed refusal from the engine.
check: pnpm exec vitest run apps/desktop/src/renderer/shell/workbench/tabs/code-editor/__tests__/source-editor-drafts.test.ts -t "retries a temporary save failure"
